optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Product Analyst, Low-Code Application Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced in defining, maintaining, and analyzing platform usage and reliability metrics for a low-code application platform, investigating anomalies, presenting findings to product and customer teams, and coordinating metric changes with engineering stakeholders.
experienceHighlights: Defined weekly active builders, app publish rate, and app error-rate metrics in the analytics warehouse using dbt on BigQuery and maintained the metric definitions page.
Investigated the April drop in app publish rate, identified a permission change in the publishing service as the root cause, and documented the fix in the analytics incident log.
Presented monthly findings to product management and quarterly findings to the customer success team using a structured deck highlighting trends, causes, and recommended follow-ups.
Coordinated metric definition changes with platform and data engineering teams through the data change process, clearly recording ownership boundaries.
Managed metric definition, anomaly investigation, stakeholder presentations, and change coordination for the low-code platform over approximately two years.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Export of the metric definitions page and the April anomaly investigation write-up, including timeline, cause, fix, verification query, and warehouse query history as a verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience in metric definition, anomaly investigation, stakeholder presentation, and change coordination for a low-code platform, but do not provide evidence of coordination with data engineering teams beyond the data change process or detailed documentation of metric definitions, limitations, and hand-over conditions.
